1331.0.0.description:
Log TestSuite PostRun failure for results publishing

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the test-suite post-run outcome for results publishing. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1331.1001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1331.1001.3242.description:
SYST-3242 - different result were seen between two commands

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the software MAC table and the hardware platform MAC table report consistent contents. The test compares the output of "show mac address-table" against "show platform table macaddr" and confirms no discrepancy is found between the two commands.

1331.1001.25005.description:
ACL configuration issue

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that an ACL can be moved between a static aggregator and an ordinary port without error. The test removes member ports from the static channel group, attaches the ACL to a free port and confirms the access-group is applied, then restores the members and re-attaches the ACL back to the aggregator, confirming it is applied there as well.

1331.1001.25717.description:
Flooding within VLAN for Windows file transfer on SBx908 Ver5.2.1-0.2 stack, no MAC address entry on the VLAN

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that intra-VLAN traffic is correctly forwarded rather than flooded and that MAC learning is consistent. The test sends learning frames from one connected test box and then another while monitoring the hardware MAC table entry count and per-port receive counts, confirming the switch learns the addresses and forwards unicast traffic to the correct port instead of flooding it across the VLAN.

1331.1001.26276.description:
Banner motd command produces error on startup on 5.3.2

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a banner motd command no longer produces an error on startup. The test configures a multi-word MOTD banner and inspects the running-config, confirming the banner command is stored and displayed correctly.

1331.1001.26422.description:
The display of VLAN of show run becomes strange

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that large VLAN ranges are displayed correctly in the running config. The test creates and removes successive VLAN ranges and then re-creates them, inspecting the running config to confirm the VLAN ranges are rendered correctly rather than in a garbled form.

1331.1001.26525.description:
LLDP - The system capabilities TLV does not advertise the correct information

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that LLDP advertises the correct system capabilities. The test inspects the LLDP local information for a port and confirms that both the Bridge and Router capabilities are correctly reported as supported and enabled.

1331.1001.26526.description:
Unable to remove vlans (not assigned to any ports) once created if vlan classifiers exist on the switch.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a VLAN can be removed even when VLAN classifiers exist on the switch. The test creates a VLAN classifier, creates a VLAN that is not assigned to any port, then deletes the VLAN and confirms the deletion succeeds regardless of the existing classifiers.

1331.1001.26725.description:
After failure "copy backupmember tftp", some files disappear from flash on every stack member

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to regress a fault where, after a failed "copy backupmember tftp", files disappeared from flash on every stack member. It would copy a backup member's flash to TFTP, induce the failure path, and confirm no flash files are lost on any member. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member stack (ran on a single unit).

1331.1001.26828.description:
show platform table macaddress shows no table for VCS master.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the platform hardware tables are consistently displayed on the VCS master. The test queries the number of instances reported for each platform table and confirms the instance count is consistent across all tables, including the MAC address table.

1331.1001.27095.description:
x600 is crashed by private vlan setting on aggregation port

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that applying a private VLAN configuration to an aggregation port no longer crashes the switch. The test attaches a port-channel to an isolated secondary VLAN and then to a community secondary VLAN, confirming each time that the primary VLAN, secondary VLAN, private-VLAN type, and aggregator membership are correctly reflected without a crash.

1331.1001.27099.description:
CR27099 - NSM crashed when removing many ports from many vlans.

[Inferred behavior — no execution history for this case] Intended to verify that removing many ports from many VLANs does not crash NSM (regressing CR27099). It would set up numerous port/VLAN memberships, remove them en masse, and confirm NSM stays alive with no exceptions. No execution history is available for this case.

1331.1001.27129.description:
LLDP - Voice vlan is confused and port disappears from vlan entries.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a port configured for voice VLAN remains correctly associated with its VLAN. The test inspects the VLAN brief output and the LLDP local information for the port, confirming the port is still listed in its VLAN and that the LLDP voice network policy is advertised correctly.

1331.1001.27186.description:
Kernel crash when running the no vlan command after static channel has been created and removed.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that removing a port from a static channel group and issuing VLAN commands no longer causes a kernel crash. The test adds a port to a static aggregator, adds the aggregator to a VLAN, then removes the port and confirms the VLAN membership is correctly displayed without a crash.

1331.1001.27201.description:
The "dhcp" directory is not created in NVS though enabling DHCP server.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the DHCP directory is recreated in NVS when needed. The test confirms the DHCP directory exists, deletes it from the underlying shell, reboots the device, and confirms the directory is automatically recreated.

1331.1001.27377.description:
Config created by COPY RUN START not shown in SH BOOT or SH SYS though config is run on startup.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a configuration saved on startup is correctly reflected in the boot and system status output. The test captures the current boot config, creates a default config from the running config and reboots, then confirms both "show boot" and "show system" report the expected config file before restoring the original boot config.

1331.1001.27478.description:
CR27478 - No interface tunnel xx crashed DUT.

[Inferred behavior — no execution history for this case] Intended to verify that the "no interface tunnel xx" command does not crash the DUT (regressing CR27478). It would create then remove a tunnel interface and confirm the device stays up with no core dump. No execution history is available for this case.

1331.1001.27496.description:
Subnet based vlan classifier rule activation log kernel errors in the log

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that activating a subnet-based VLAN classifier rule no longer logs kernel errors. The test clears the logs, applies a VLAN classifier group to two ports and then removes it, inspecting the log each time to confirm no kernel-error messages are present.

1331.1001.27592.description:
Static mac-address does not appear in the running config when port-security is configured on a non-default VLAN.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a static MAC address appears in the running config when port-security is configured on a non-default VLAN. The test assigns an IP to a VLAN, adds a port with port-security, establishes connectivity to the connected test box, and confirms the learned static MAC entry is present in the running config.

1331.1001.27593.description:
Test to help create CR-87931

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies stable behaviour of port-security on a stack, reproducing the conditions of the associated change request. The test confirms the stack reaches a good state, configures port-security on a VLAN port, establishes connectivity to the connected test box, then clears the configuration and confirms the stack remains in a good state.

1331.1001.27620.description:
Unexpected router solicitation transmitted on bootup. IPv6 not configured.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that no unexpected control packets are transmitted on bootup when IPv6 is not configured. The test reboots the device while capturing packets on several connected test box interfaces and confirms that no unsolicited multicast packets are received on any of them.

1331.1001.27816.description:
BGP CLI freezes when exiting from "address-family ipv4 multicast" mode.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the BGP CLI no longer freezes when exiting address-family configuration mode. The test enters a BGP instance and the IPv4 multicast address-family, issues exit, and confirms the prompt returns promptly.

1331.1001.27884.description:
Not able to apply storm-protection based qos policy to an interface

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a storm-protection-based QoS policy can be applied to an interface. The test attaches a policy-map containing QoS storm-protection settings to multiple ports and confirms via the QoS interface output that the policy-map and its storm-protection parameters are correctly applied.

1331.1001.27965.description:
Port mirroring in the transmit direction does not work across a stack

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that transmit-direction port mirroring works across a stack. The test sets up mirroring and captures the mirrored protocol BPDUs on the connected test box, confirming the transmitted frames are correctly mirrored.

1331.1001.28334.description:
When QoS entry more than 1024 was configured to LAG ports in VCS environment, x900 crashes

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that configuring a large number of QoS entries on aggregated ports in a VCS environment no longer crashes the switch. The test baselines classifier utilization, creates multiple static channel groups, and applies a policy-map with many class-maps, confirming the QoS configuration is applied correctly without a crash.

1331.1001.28516.description:
Trigger does not work correctly in Host Attach environment when Backup Member joined

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that triggers fire correctly in a Host Attach environment after a backup member joins the stack. It would configure a trigger, add a backup member, and confirm the trigger still activates as expected. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member stack (ran on a single unit).

1331.1001.28722.description:
The port number range setting of the access list of TCP is illegally matched

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that TCP port-range ACL matching is no longer applied incorrectly. The test learns the connected test box MAC, sends a mix of TCP and UDP packets and confirms they all pass, then attaches the port-range ACLs and confirms the packets that should not match the range still pass rather than being illegally matched and dropped.

1331.1001.29055.description:
Web auth supplicant in the guest vlan can communicate to other vlan interface on x900

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a web-auth supplicant in the guest VLAN cannot reach other VLAN interfaces. The test confirms baseline connectivity before auth-web is enabled, configures web authentication with guest VLANs on ports, and confirms guest-VLAN ARP and inter-VLAN reachability behave as expected so a guest cannot communicate with other VLAN interfaces.

1331.1001.29340.description:
Radius : error message when importing users to Local Radius Server

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that users can be imported into the local RADIUS server without error messages. The test exports the local RADIUS user database to a CSV file, replaces the database from the file, deletes the users, then re-imports them from the CSV and confirms both users are present afterwards.

1331.1001.29521.description:
Some log configuration does not appear in SHOW RUN CONFIG

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that all log configuration settings appear in the running config. The test configures buffered, program, and console message-text log filters, then confirms each setting appears both in "show running-config" and in "show log config".

1331.1001.29727.description:
When IP access-list with MAC Address is set by protocol type "IP", it is changed to proto 256 on running-conf

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that an IP access-list rule matching a MAC address with protocol type "ip" is stored correctly. The test inspects the running config and confirms the ACL rule is displayed with the "ip" protocol keyword rather than being changed to a numeric protocol value.

1331.1001.30437.description:
Even if Supplicant moves from the authentication port port to non-authentication port, the authentication information is not

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that authentication information does not incorrectly persist when a supplicant moves from an authenticating port to a non-authenticating port. The test transmits a crafted frame from one connected test box, confirms the MAC is learned and the supplicant is authenticated on the first port and not on the other ports, then transmits from another test box to confirm correct relearning.

1331.1001.30666.description:
Non-consecutive bit mask for ACLs not allowed

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that ACLs with non-consecutive bit masks are now permitted and enforced. The test confirms multiple such ACLs exist and are attached to a port, confirms that matching packets are forwarded, then detaches the ACLs and confirms the packets are discarded.

1331.1001.30675.description:
Private VLAN does not work on 534, related to CR30322.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that private VLANs operate correctly. The test transmits traffic between promiscuous, isolated, and community ports and confirms that primary-to-secondary and secondary-to-primary traffic flows while traffic between isolated and community ports is blocked.

1331.1001.30677.description:
Policy-map cannot be re-attached after getting dettached from some ports.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a policy-map can be re-attached after being detached from ports. The test attaches the policy-map to all switch ports and confirms via the QoS output that the policy-map, its class-maps, and match criteria are correctly configured on every port.

1331.1001.30768.description:
Weighted round robin of QoS on SA incorrectly added to running-config (r6 only)

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that weighted round robin QoS is correctly rejected on aggregators and not added to the running config. The test attempts to configure WRR on a static channel group and on a dynamic channel group, confirms each command is rejected, and confirms no WRR setting is added to the running config.

1331.1001.30785.description:
A differential behaviors occur on 533 and 534 using ACL TCP-flags

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies consistent ACL TCP-flags matching behaviour. The test configures a policy-map matching specific TCP flag combinations, transmits packets with a range of flag combinations from the connected test box, and confirms that only the intended combinations are matched and forwarded while the others are discarded.

1331.1001.31361.description:
log email command is broken on 534 and does not get added dynamically

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the log email command works and is added to the running config dynamically. The test configures the log email recipient, SMTP server, and source address, then inspects the running config to confirm all three email settings are present.

1331.1001.32197.description:
multicast traffic not been passed with Private Vlans

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that multicast traffic is correctly handled with private VLANs. The test transmits multicast traffic between isolated, community, and promiscuous ports and confirms that traffic flows to and from the promiscuous port while traffic between isolated and community ports is blocked.

1331.1001.32405.description:
When a disabled vlan is allocated to a switchport, it should be rejected and display an error message

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that allocating a disabled VLAN to a switchport is rejected with an error message. The test creates a disabled VLAN, attempts to assign it as a port's access VLAN, confirms the operation fails with an error, and confirms the running config contains no VLAN allocation for that port.

1331.1001.34919.description:
CR34919 - [AW+] GUI user authentication password can't be changed.

[Inferred behavior — no execution history for this case] Intended to verify that a GUI user's authentication password can be changed (regressing CR34919). It would change a web/GUI user password and confirm the new password takes effect. No execution history is available for this case.

1331.1001.35165.description:
ACL configuration issue

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that hardware ACL filters are properly removed when an ACL is modified on an aggregator. The test removes member ports from one static channel group, creates another aggregator and attaches the ACL to it, makes a change to the ACL, and confirms the hardware filter access group is properly removed.

1331.1001.36836.description:
Some configs are removed from running-config after IMI process is killed

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that configuration is no longer lost from the running-config when the IMI process is killed. The test confirms that unsaved configuration commands are correctly journalled to an unsaved-config file, simulates repeated IMI health-check failures so the process is killed and core dumps, then checks that the expected core files were generated and the affected port can be re-enabled, confirming the surviving configuration is intact.

1331.1001.38178.description:
x900 Stack: The egress rate limit config was removed after the master failover occurred.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that egress rate-limit configuration is preserved across a stack master failover. It would configure egress rate limiting, force a master failover, and confirm the rate-limit config survives. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member stack (ran on a single unit).

1331.1001.38354.description:
diff -B option ignores more than just blank lines

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that the "diff -B" option ignores only blank lines and still detects real content differences between two files. It compares files with and without the -B option and confirms differences are correctly reported. Reported UNSUPPORTED on the current setup because the file-diff behaviour could not be exercised as expected.

1331.1001.39568.description:
MLDv2 report is reflected with MAC of sender on AW+

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that an MLDv2 report is no longer reflected back out with the sender's MAC address. The test sends an MLD query from the connected test box so the switch learns the router port, then sends MLD reports while capturing on the same interface, confirming the switch does not echo the reports back on the ingress link.

1331.1001.39590.description:
CR39590 - x510-28GSX does not report PSU2 power bad

[Inferred behavior — no execution history for this case] Intended to verify that an x510-28GSX correctly reports a bad PSU2 power state (regressing CR39590). It would induce/observe a PSU2 fault condition and confirm the switch reports the power-bad status. No execution history is available for this case.

1331.1001.40169.description:
Unable to communicate to CPU from the promiscuous port on BCM products since 543.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the switch CPU is again reachable through a promiscuous port. The test configures a promiscuous (private-VLAN) port and pings the DUT's management address through it from the connected test box, confirming the ping succeeds with no loss.

1331.1001.40190.description:
The egress-rate-limit can not apply the configuration correctly on VCS.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that egress-rate-limit configuration is applied correctly and persists on a VCS stack. The test configures WRR egress-rate-limit on an aggregator and a switch port, reboots the DUT, and confirms the running-config for both interfaces is identical before and after the reboot.

1331.1001.40292.description:
An unnecessary log is outputted, when IPv6 Multicast Packet is received.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that no unnecessary log message is generated when an IPv6 multicast packet is received. The test synchronises the clock, captures the log baseline, transmits an IPv6 multicast packet, and checks the log to confirm the spurious entry no longer appears.

1331.1001.40312.description:
The forwarded packet by UDP broadcast helper could be wrong

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a packet forwarded by the UDP broadcast helper has the correct UDP checksum. The test learns the destination MAC on a port, crafts a UDP packet and computes the expected post-routing checksum, sends it from the connected test box, captures it on the egress interface, and confirms the received checksum matches the expected value.

1331.1001.41251.description:
If IGMP Snooping feature is disabled. multicast packets does not flood after V2 or V3 report packets was received.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that multicast packets are correctly flooded after an IGMPv2/v3 report is received while IGMP snooping is disabled. With snooping disabled, the test sends an IGMP join, then transmits multicast UDP packets and captures on another interface, confirming the multicast traffic is flooded and received as expected.

1331.1001.41569.description:
Regardless of ACL deny action is set, packet which is matched the ACL isnt disarded occasionally.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that packets matching an ACL deny action are reliably discarded rather than occasionally leaking through. The test confirms that TCP packets with both SYN and ACK flags set are forwarded, that packets with only one of those flags or non-matching UDP traffic are dropped, and that disabling QoS allows the previously discarded packets through, confirming the ACL match is deterministic.

1331.1001.41602.description:
Stack: The log size config was removed after rolling reboot.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that log-size configuration is preserved across a rolling reboot of a stack. It would set a non-default log size, perform a rolling reboot, and confirm the setting survives. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it is not supported on standalone (non-stacked) devices.

1331.1001.42016.description:
When adding and removing vlans and ip helper, imi crashed with 5.4.3-3.7 and main.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that IMI no longer crashes when VLANs and IP helper are repeatedly added and removed. The test loops through many iterations of adding and removing VLAN and IP-helper configuration, confirming IMI stays up with no crash.

1331.1001.42500.description:
If execute the command of [dot1x eap forward-vlan],can not pass through the EAP frame.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the dot1x eap forward-vlan command correctly passes EAP frames through. The test transmits untagged and tagged EAP packets with the feature deconfigured and confirms none are forwarded, then enables dot1x eap forward-vlan and confirms all EAP packets are forwarded, then deconfigures it and confirms forwarding stops again.

1331.1001.42562.description:
MAC Thrashing Traps are sent out when thrash-limiting action none.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that MAC-thrashing SNMP traps are not sent when the thrash-limiting action is none. The test induces MAC thrashing by injecting frames with RSTP disabled while capturing on the management interface; with the action set to link-down it confirms the thrashing traps are received, and with the action set to none it confirms no thrashing traps are sent.

1331.1001.42563.description:
Node which belong to secondary port of Private VLAN can communicate other VLAN when each ARP information are registered.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that a host on a private-VLAN secondary (isolated) port cannot reach another VLAN even when ARP entries are pre-registered. It would build a private VLAN, register ARP entries, and confirm cross-VLAN communication from the isolated port is blocked. Reported UNSUPPORTED because the private-VLAN configuration could not be applied on this device.

1331.1001.42644.description:
Trunk port configured "native vlan none" transmits untagged packets.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a trunk port configured with native vlan none no longer transmits untagged packets. The test transmits frames into the trunk port and captures on the egress interfaces, confirming no untagged packets are emitted.

1331.1001.50241.description:
IGMP Snooping - Multicast traffic is dropped instead of flooded when DUT first receives multicast traffic

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that multicast traffic is flooded rather than dropped when the DUT first receives it under IGMP snooping. The test configures a downstream interface for a multicast group, clears counters and entries, transmits crafted multicast packets, and confirms the group is learnt and the port counters reflect the traffic being forwarded rather than dropped.

1331.1001.50328.description:
VCS Resiliency link does not work

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that a VCS resiliency link operates correctly. It would configure a resiliency link and confirm it carries stack control traffic and behaves as expected. Reported UNSUPPORTED because no resiliency links are configured/applicable on this single-unit setup.

1331.1001.50488.description:
x310: platform stop-unreg-mcast command, kills multicast traffic

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the platform stop-unreg-mcast command no longer kills multicast traffic. The test joins a multicast group from two test-box interfaces, streams multicast packets, toggles platform stop-unreg-mc-flooding on and off mid-stream while capturing, and confirms the traffic continues uninterrupted with no visible effect on forwarding.

1331.1001.51900.description:
The switch doesn't register MAC Address into FDB when we use the combination with Protocol VLAN and LAG.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the switch registers a MAC address into the FDB when Protocol VLAN is combined with a LAG. The test confirms the aggregator belongs to the protocol VLAN, sends an IPv6 packet to be received on the LAG, and confirms the source MAC is correctly learnt on the aggregator in the FDB.

1331.1001.52406.description:
Tx mirroring does not work for IGMP packet via CPU.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that Tx mirroring works for IGMP packets that traverse the CPU. The test configures a mirror port and transmits IGMP queries into an ingress port, confirming that both ingress (Rx) and egress (Tx) mirroring deliver the expected packet counts to the monitor interface across the relevant source-port configurations.

1331.1001.52430.description:
IP Subnet VLAN does not work because a packet does not handle by appropriate rule

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that IP Subnet VLAN classification works because packets are handled by the appropriate rule. The test sends frames from distinct subnet sources across several ingress ports and confirms each source MAC is learnt on the correct subnet-mapped VLAN.

1331.1001.52769.description:
CR-52769 - Adding and removing static channels crashes nsm

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that NSM no longer crashes when static channels are added and removed. The test repeatedly adds and removes static channel-group configuration and confirms NSM stays up with no crash.

1331.1001.52829.description:
"no nas 127.0.0.1" command on the Radius Server mode, it is not possible to Write to Config

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the loopback NAS can be removed on the local RADIUS server and the removal is written to config. The test configures the local RADIUS server, confirms the loopback NAS is created, removes it, reboots the DUT, and confirms the loopback NAS remains absent after reboot.

1331.1001.53752.description:
Check release file size is not too big

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the release file is not too large to fit on the device. The test reads the flash size and current release size and confirms two copies of the release can be stored with free space remaining.

1331.1001.54492.description:
dhcp-server crash when offering infinite lease time

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the DHCP server no longer crashes when offering an infinite lease time. The test configures a DHCP pool with infinite lease, brings up DHCP clients on the test-box interfaces, confirms bindings are issued with infinite expiry, then disconnects links and clears the bindings, confirming no errors or crash occur.

1331.1001.54553.description:
RIP metric is not updated properly when receiving the update packets.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the RIP metric is updated correctly when update packets are received. The test sends RIP updates for a network at various metrics, including poison (metric 16) followed by a lower metric in quick succession and one-by-one, and confirms the route metric in the RIP table reflects the correct received value each time.

1331.1001.54751.description:
IP subnet vlan is transmit incorrectly when received ARP

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that IP Subnet VLAN traffic is transmitted correctly when an ARP is received. The test exchanges ARP request/reply packets in both directions, confirms each port receives the correct ARP packets, and confirms the resulting MAC-address table entries are correct.

1331.1001.55661.description:
imi crash while loading the configuration with invalid character in user password hash

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that IMI no longer crashes when loading configuration containing an invalid character in a user password hash. The test attempts to add a user whose hash contains an invalid character and confirms the hash is rejected and the username is not saved to the running config.

1331.1001.56365.description:
Unable to handle type 6 IGMPv3 leave when using snooping querier

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that an IGMPv3 type 6 (block old sources) leave is handled correctly when using the snooping querier. The test sends a type 5 allow record and confirms the group registers, then sends a type 6 block record and confirms the group is deregistered within the expected window.

1331.1001.56486.description:
Unexpected error handling of IGMPv3 for the member which is already removed

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies correct error handling of an IGMPv3 record that blocks a non-existent source while adding a new source. The test sends the combined block/add group record, checks the syslog, and confirms the new group source is accepted and present in the IGMP groups table without error.

1331.1001.56496.description:
IGMP fast-leave is not working for IGMPv3 type 6 Leave(Block old sources)

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that IGMP fast-leave works for an IGMPv3 type 6 (block old sources) leave. The test registers a group with a type 5 allow record, sends a type 6 block record, and confirms the group is deregistered within the expected window and that no group-source query is sent when fast-leave is enabled.

1331.1001.56809.description:
Private-vlans: Kernel Panic on de-configuring private-vlans

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that deconfiguring private VLANs no longer causes a kernel panic. The test configures private VLANs, attempts deconfiguration in various orders including failing port-deconfigure attempts, reconfigures so ports can be removed, then fully deconfigures the ports and VLANs, confirming no kernel panic occurs.

1331.1001.56841.description:
If disabling port-security aging, lock action doesnot work correctly in Marvell products

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the port-security lock action works correctly when aging is disabled on Marvell products. With aging off, the test confirms the port starts unlocked, brings the interface up, confirms it transitions to LOCKED after a MAC is learnt, then simulates a client disconnect/reconnect and confirms the lock state remains correct.

1331.1001.57280.description:
Vlan range command does not get applied whern used in format 1-N

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a VLAN range command is applied when expressed in the 1-N format. The test issues a vlan range command in that format and confirms the full range of VLANs is correctly enabled.

1331.1001.57311.description:
Port not working in new VLAN after private-vlan configuration is removed from it

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a port works in a new VLAN after private-VLAN configuration is removed from it. The test confirms the port cannot initially reach the target VLAN, removes the private-VLAN configuration and reconfigures the port as an access port in the new VLAN, then pings the VLAN SVI and confirms connectivity is restored.

1331.1001.57875.description:
CR-57875 - crash when running show tech-support

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that running show tech-support no longer causes a crash. The test confirms the stack is in a healthy synchronised state with consistent running-config, runs show tech-support to completion, deletes the generated file, and confirms the stack remains healthy afterward.

1331.1001.57954.description:
(JITC) Cannot apply QoS policy matching IPv4 and IPv6 ICMP ACL to interface on 5.4.7B on x908NG

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a QoS policy whose ACLs match both IPv4 and IPv6 ICMP can be applied to an interface. The test applies the service-policy to an interface and confirms the policy map is accepted successfully.

1331.1001.58756.description:
Broadcom switches send back NLB heartbeat packet to receiving port, resulting in ping fail to actual IP address

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that NLB heartbeat packets are not sent back out the receiving port, so the actual IP address remains reachable. The test transmits NLB heartbeat packets and repeatedly confirms that the switch does not reflect them back to the receiving port.

1331.1001.58848.description:
Unable to set MRU on provisioning port.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that MRU can be set on a provisioning (offline) stack port. It would provision a port and configure its MRU, confirming the value is accepted. Reported UNSUPPORTED because port provisioning is not supported on this device.

1331.1001.58865.description:
LAG configuration with private-vlan is removed after VCS failover

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that LAG configuration combined with private-VLAN survives a VCS failover. The test confirms the LAG settings are present, triggers a master failover, and confirms the LAG configuration is still present afterward.

1331.1001.58914.description:
NSM core dump while deconfiguring channel-group

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that NSM no longer core dumps when deconfiguring a channel-group. The test configures and then deconfigures channel-group membership across ports and confirms NSM stays up with no core dump.

1331.1001.58947.description:
Copy run to tftp command would fail if it is executed via trigger activated script

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the copy running-config to TFTP command works when invoked from a trigger-activated script. Activates a trigger that runs a backup script and confirms the running-config was successfully copied to the TFTP server, ensuring the historical trigger-context failure no longer occurs.

1331.1001.59217.description:
NSM core dumps on x930 and DC2552XS following adding/removing IGMP proxy configuration

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that adding and removing IGMP proxy-service and mroute-proxy configuration across VLAN interfaces no longer crashes NSM. Cycles through the IGMP proxy/mroute-proxy configure and unconfigure commands and confirms no NSM core dump is triggered.

1331.1001.59342.description:
GS948MX 'show platform port' causes 10G SFP+ port link down / UP

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that running show tech-support and show platform port no longer disrupts 10G SFP+ port links. Brings ports to a stable state, clears the log, runs the diagnostic commands, then checks the log to confirm no port link down/up disruptions were recorded.

1331.1001.59681.description:
Show system broken after change the stack management subnet

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that show system output remains correct after changing the stack management subnet. Confirms show system and show system environment display correctly, changes the stack management subnet, saves and reloads, then re-checks the output to ensure it is still rendered correctly.

1331.1001.61197.description:
Cannot configure vlan name as lowercase default vlan name

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that VLAN names matching the lowercase default-style naming convention can be configured. Creates VLANs with a variety of valid names (lowercase, mixed-case, numeric, spaced, and maximum-length) and an over-length invalid name, then confirms via show vlan that each VLAN displays the expected name and the invalid name is rejected.

1331.1001.61361.description:
After core switch bootup, IPv6 link-local address is not generated.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that IPv6 link-local addresses are generated for all IPv6 interfaces after a port comes up. Configures the maximum number of IPv6 interfaces via an uploaded script with a port disabled, then brings the port up and confirms every IPv6 interface has a corresponding link-local address.

1331.1001.61985.description:
syslog-ng fails to change setting

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the syslog host source-interface setting can be changed correctly. For each configured VLAN source interface, triggers syslog messages, sniffs them on the connected test box, and confirms the messages arrive at the syslog servers carrying the correct source address.

1331.1001.62365.description:
Communication fail after change the svi ip address

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that connectivity is maintained after changing a switched virtual interface IP address. Pings the SVI from the connected test box, changes the SVI IP address, and pings again to confirm communication still succeeds.

1331.1001.62394.description:
UnReg MC Group were limited by the "ip igmp limit" command. But the IGMP group can not be limited by this command.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the ip igmp limit command correctly limits unregistered multicast groups without errors. Sends a large volume of unregistered multicast packets, checks the hardware multicast table, and confirms the syslog shows no errors while the multicast traffic is handled.

1331.1001.63126.description:
New command to allow ARPs for autoconfigure address 169.254.x.x from 0.0.0.0 in ARP security

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify a new ARP-security command that permits ARPs for link-local autoconfigure addresses (169.254.x.x) sourced from 0.0.0.0. It would enable ARP security, send such ARPs, and confirm the port stays up and the packets are handled correctly. Reported UNSUPPORTED because the required ARP-security commands are not available on this device.

1331.1001.63720.description:
ipv6 nd prefix lifetime parameters accepted, but not shown in running configuration

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that ipv6 nd prefix lifetime parameters are retained in the running configuration. Configures an IPv6 ND prefix with valid and preferred lifetimes on a VLAN interface and confirms the lifetime parameters appear in show running-config.

1331.1001.65611.description:
QSP storm-protection cannot be set to multiple switch chips at the same time

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that QoS storm-protection can be enabled on ports spanning multiple switch chips simultaneously. Enables storm protection on ports on different chips and confirms via show mls qos interface storm-status that the feature is enabled on each port.

1331.1001.65743.description:
DLF packets are incorrectly flooded to the CPU

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that destination-lookup-failure (unknown unicast) packets are not flooded to the CPU. Sends packets with unknown destination MAC addresses to the switch and uses debug platform packet to confirm no DLF packets are captured by the CPU.

1331.1001.66502.description:
Login banner is not displayed

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a configured login banner is displayed. Sets a login banner, confirms it via show banner login, then logs out and back in to confirm the banner is presented at the login prompt.

1331.1001.66812.description:
Multicast traffic is not forwarded by static multicast route without FL01 license

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that multicast traffic is forwarded over a static multicast route without a full feature license. Sends multicast packets and confirms reception with a full license, then removes all licenses except the base/access license, reloads, and confirms the multicast packets are still received.

1331.1001.67301.description:
Check stack remains stable when subjected to ARP storm, default VLAN

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the stack remains stable when subjected to an ARP storm on the default VLAN. Creates a loop-back link and pings a non-existent address from the connected test box to generate the storm, lets it run, then stops it and confirms no crash or exception occurred during the storm.

1331.1001.67985.description:
Trigger "day 1-31" parameter not activating the trigger

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a time-based trigger configured with a day-of-month parameter activates correctly. Configures a trigger to fire on a specific day, waits for the scheduled time, then confirms via show trigger and the log that the trigger activated and its script executed.

1331.1001.67995.description:
Check sflow configuration is restored after reboot

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that sFlow configuration is restored after a reboot. Confirms sFlow is configured, saves the running-config and reboots, then compares the before and after running-configurations to confirm there are no configuration differences.

1331.1001.68737.description:
The log facility command does not work

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the log facility command takes effect for all syslog facilities. For each selectable facility, configures it and confirms the generated syslog messages carry the correct facility value.

1331.1001.70764.description:
Cannot edit hardware access-list containing acl-group while applied to interface

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a hardware access-list containing an ACL group can be edited while applied to an interface. Applies the hardware access-list to an interface and confirms it can be both edited and removed without error.

1331.1001.72144.description:
VCS sync timeout log message after repeated link-up/link-down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that repeated link-up/link-down activity does not produce VCS sync timeout log messages. Runs many shut/no-shut cycles on ports with varying timing and link-action timeouts, then checks show log and show log permanent to confirm no errors were logged.

1331.1001.73175.description:
GS948MX L3 forwarding path can be manipulated by sending crafted ARP packets

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the L3 forwarding path cannot be manipulated by crafted ARP packets. Sends spoofed ARP request and response packets from a non-local, unreachable source address and confirms the switch drops them and does not register the spoofed ARP entry.

1331.1001.75853.description:
Console speed setting not changed by CLI

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the console speed setting is applied via the CLI. Changes the console baud rate, reconnects at the new rate to confirm it is in effect, then resets it to the original rate and reconnects again to confirm.

1331.1001.76741.description:
wrr-queue queue-limit command is not set for both instances

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that the wrr-queue queue-limit command is applied to both packet-processor instances. It would set the egress queue-limit to maximum on all ports and confirm the limit changes on every instance. Reported UNSUPPORTED because the egress queue-limit could not be changed on this device.

1331.1001.77088.description:
hostd crash setting boot configuration

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that hostd does not crash when boot configuration is set repeatedly. Cycles through applying a series of different boot configuration files to the switch over multiple iterations and confirms each cycle completes without a hostd crash.

1331.1001.77339.description:
When port-up is performed with "ip summary-address rip" set, the ripd process may terminate abnormally

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that bringing a port up with ip summary-address rip configured does not abnormally terminate the ripd process. Applies the RIP summary-address configuration, brings the port up, and confirms no exceptions occurred.

1331.1001.79624.description:
MSTP config not applied during boot on IE340

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that MSTP configuration is correctly applied during boot. Boots the switch with MSTP configured and confirms the configuration is applied without the historical boot-time failure.

1331.1001.80881.description:
Specifying a range of switch ports that do not exist will cause a coredump, configure

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that configuring a range of switch ports, including non-existent ones, does not cause a core dump. Selects valid interface ranges and confirms no crash, then attempts invalid out-of-range port ranges and confirms they are rejected without any crash.

1331.1001.83115.description:
VLAN stacking cannot be configured test

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that VLAN stacking can be configured. Randomly selects a subset of ports and configures VLAN stacking on them, confirming the configuration succeeds.

1331.1001.87878.description:
sflowd does not crash when sflow collector with VRF is configured and device reboots

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that sflowd does not crash when an sFlow collector with a VRF is configured and the device reboots. Confirms the sFlow VRF collector is present, saves and reboots, then checks for core files and confirms the VRF collector configuration remains intact with no crash.

1331.1001.88232.description:
Test IP connectivity of a single "no switchport" interface

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies IP connectivity over a single routed (no switchport) interface. Reboots with the test config, confirms the no-switchport port is not a member of any VLAN, assigns it an IP address, and pings the connected test box to confirm Layer 3 connectivity succeeds.

1331.1001.527690.description:
Adding and removing static channels crashes nsm

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that repeatedly adding and removing static channel-groups does not crash NSM. It would create and tear down many static channels and confirm NSM stays alive with no exceptions. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires more switch ports than this unit provides.

1331.1001.673010.description:
Check stack remains stable when subjected to ARP storm, non-default VLAN

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the stack remains stable when subjected to an ARP storm on a non-default VLAN. Creates a loop-back link and pings a non-existent address from the connected test box to generate the storm, lets it run, then stops it and confirms no crash or exception occurred during the storm.

1331.1001.808810.description:
Specifying a range of switch ports that do not exist will cause a coredump, show interface

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that show interface and show interface brief over a range of switch ports, including non-existent ones, do not cause a core dump. Runs the show commands over valid ranges with no crash, then over invalid out-of-range ranges and confirms they are rejected without any crash.

1331.1001.808811.description:
Specifying a range of switch ports that do not exist will cause a coredump, show run

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that show run interface over a range of switch ports, including non-existent ones, does not cause a core dump. Runs the command over valid ranges with no crash, then over invalid out-of-range ranges and confirms they are rejected without any crash.

1331.1001.808812.description:
Specifying a range of ports that do not exist will cause a coredump, eth ports

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that selecting a range of eth ports, including non-existent ones, does not cause a core dump. Runs interface selection and the show interface, show interface brief, and show run interface commands over valid eth ranges and over a variety of invalid ranges, confirming the invalid ranges are rejected without any crash.

1331.1001.882320.description:
Test IP connectivity of multiple "no switchport" interfaces

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies IP connectivity over multiple routed (no switchport) interfaces. Reboots with the test config, confirms the no-switchport ports are not members of any VLAN, assigns each an IP address, and pings the connected test box from each to confirm Layer 3 connectivity succeeds on all of them.

1331.2001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1331.2001.21013.description:
CR21013 - x900-24XT does not send the ARP request.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the switch re-sends ARP requests after dynamic ARP entries age out. Populates the ARP table by pinging neighbours, waits for the entries to age out, then pings again and confirms the switch issues fresh ARP requests so the pings succeed.

1331.2001.22564.description:
CR22564 - SNMP Trap is sent from 192.168.255.1 which is VCS management IP

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that an SNMP trap is not sourced from the VCS management IP (192.168.255.1). It would trigger a trap and confirm its source address is a real interface IP, not the internal stack management address. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member stack (ran on a single unit).

1331.2001.22620.description:
CR22620 - IP routing of IP subnet vlan issue

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies IP routing between IP-subnet VLANs. Crafts and transmits a packet from the connected test box into one VLAN and confirms it is routed and arrives on the interface in the other VLAN, then repeats in the reverse direction.

1331.2001.22960.description:
CR22960 - x900 sends a wrong ARP reply to an ARP request sender after the same VLAN is re-created

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that re-creating a VLAN does not cause the switch to send a wrong ARP reply to an ARP request sender. Establishes IP connectivity and pings the switch from the connected test box, then removes and re-configures the VLAN as before, confirming the ping still succeeds and the switch responds correctly after the VLAN is re-created.

1331.2001.23355.description:
CR23355 - When time is synchronized by NTP, after that "clock set" command is excute, this device cannot synchronize time by NTP

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that once time is synchronised by NTP, a manual "clock set" is rejected and NTP synchronisation is retained. It would establish NTP sync, attempt a manual clock set, and confirm it fails. Reported UNSUPPORTED on the current setup because NTP synchronisation could not be established as required.

1331.2001.24462.description:
CR24462 - Cannot disable the snmp function when it has been enabled once

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the SNMP server can be disabled after it has been enabled. Confirms the SNMP server is initially running, disables it and checks that it reports as disabled, then re-enables it and confirms it is running again, ensuring the disable operation is no longer blocked once SNMP has been enabled.

1331.2001.25172.description:
CR25172 - About behavior of the system clock in VCS

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies correct system-clock behaviour in a VCS stack. Sets the clock to a known date and time, reboots the active master from the CLI, and confirms after the master failover that the clock remains correctly set rather than being reset.

1331.2001.26425.description:
CR26425 - Stress testing with SNMP walk causes memory leak.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that repeated SNMP walks do not cause a memory leak. Performs SNMPv2c and SNMPv3 walks of the full MIB tree against each stack member simultaneously over several trials, confirming the walks complete and the switch does not leak memory under the stress.

1331.2001.27142.description:
CR27142 - VRRP: Default AUTH type set as 1 instead of 0.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the VRRP advertisement authentication type defaults to none rather than being incorrectly set. Captures VRRP advertisements emitted by the switch on the connected test box and confirms that every received VRRP packet has its auth type field set to none.

1331.2001.27867.description:
CR27867 - If IP subnet VLAN function is enabled in 5.3.2-0.2, the communication is impossible

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that communication still works with the IP subnet VLAN function enabled. Configures subnet-based VLANs on the switch and pings between hosts on each VLAN segment from the connected test box, confirming traffic is forwarded and connectivity is not broken.

1331.2001.27875.description:
CR27875 - LLDP - SNMP Protocol Ids (Annex F) are not aligned with local info on the switch

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the LLDP SNMP protocol IDs (Annex F) are aligned with the local information on the switch. Retrieves the LLDP local protocol IDs for all switch ports via the CLI and via SNMP, then confirms IPv4 connectivity and asserts that the protocol-ID sets retrieved by both methods match exactly.

1331.2001.27941.description:
CR27941 - Dynamic routes are distributed even though the route is filtered by the distribute-list out filter.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that dynamic routes filtered by a "distribute-list out" filter are not advertised. It would configure RIP with an outbound distribute-list, capture RIP updates, and confirm the filtered routes are absent. Reported UNSUPPORTED on the current setup because the expected RIP packets were not received.

1331.2001.28437.description:
CR28437 - snmp - Private mib - triggerTraps trap/object is incorrect.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the private-MIB triggerTraps trap reports the correct trap OID and object. Configures a periodic trigger and captures the SNMP traps it sends to the connected test box, confirming the trap is a correct SNMPv2 trap carrying the expected trigger trap OID for each activation.

1331.2001.28647.description:
CR28647 - Web Auth does not work in VCS Backup port

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that web authentication works on a VCS backup port. Configures a RADIUS server and attempts to authenticate through a port on the backup member from the connected test box, confirming the web authentication gateway page is served and authentication proceeds.

1331.2001.28981.description:
CR28981 - Packet is duplicated if the source and dest IP are different from DUT interface route and nexthop is the same as RX interface

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that one-arm routed packets are not duplicated when the source and destination IP differ from the DUT interface route and the next hop is the same as the receive interface. Transmits packets from the test box that the switch routes back out the same interface, captures them, and confirms exactly one routed copy per packet is returned rather than duplicates.

1331.2001.29573.description:
CR29573 - L3 routing pkts cant be discarded by ACL(HWF or QoS policy map) on a interface enabled both port auth and ACL.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that L3 routed packets can be discarded by an ACL (hardware filter or QoS policy-map) on an interface that has both port authentication and an ACL applied. It would authenticate, apply the ACL, and confirm matching traffic is dropped. Reported UNSUPPORTED on the current setup because the supplicant could not be authenticated as required.

1331.2001.29976.description:
CR29976 - ARP is not added to ARP table after disabling vlan classifier configuration (no vlan classifier activate)

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that ARP entries are still added to the ARP table after VLAN classifier configuration is removed. Pings hosts from the switch to populate the ARP table and confirms entries exist, then clears the cache, deletes the VLAN classifier configuration, and pings again to confirm ARP resolution still works.

1331.2001.30054.description:
CR30054 - ARP request and reply are not sent after "vlan xx state disable" and "vlan xx state enable"

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that ARP requests and replies resume after a VLAN is disabled and re-enabled. Confirms ping from the switch succeeds, disables the VLAN and confirms ping fails as expected, then re-enables the VLAN and confirms ping succeeds again, proving ARP traffic is sent after the state toggle.

1331.2001.30526.description:
CR32526 - DUT can not clear counters of ping-poll.

[Inferred behavior — no execution history for this case] Intended to verify that the DUT can clear ping-poll counters (regressing CR32526). It would run ping-poll, clear its counters, and confirm the counters reset to zero. No execution history is available for this case.

1331.2001.32400.description:
CR32400 - When the trigger works for the member leave, the SMTP(mail) packet is transmitted two times.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that, when a member-leave trigger fires, the SMTP (mail) packet is transmitted only once rather than duplicated. It would configure a mail trigger, induce a member-leave event, and count the SMTP packets sent. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member stack (ran on a single unit).

1331.2001.32526.description:
CR32526 - DUT can not clear counters of ping-poll.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that ping-poll counters can be cleared. Confirms a configured ping poll reaches the up state and that its counters are incrementing, then clears the counters and confirms they are reset to zero.

1331.2001.33939.description:
CR33939 - SNMP Traps vcstackMemberLeaveNotify and vcstackStkPortLinkDownNotify are sent when a stack member powers down

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that the vcstackMemberLeaveNotify and vcstackStkPortLinkDownNotify SNMP traps are sent when a stack member powers down. It would power down a member and confirm both traps are emitted. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member stack (ran on a single unit).

1331.2001.35288.description:
CR35288 - log emails keep added to the queue in backup member

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that log emails do not keep accumulating in the queue on a backup member. Sends a test mail and confirms the mail queue empties, then flaps a port to trigger a log email and confirms the mail is sent and the queue does not build up.

1331.2001.39213.description:
CR39213 - Web authentication page does not display when customer accessed web page.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the web authentication page is displayed when a client accesses a web page. Configures RADIUS and web-based authentication, confirms unauthenticated ports do not route traffic, then has supplicants on the test box trigger and complete web authentication, confirming the auth page is served and supplicants become authorized.

1331.2001.39349.description:
CR39349 - Web-Auth memory leak

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that repeated web-authentication logins do not cause a memory leak. Configures a RADIUS server, records the authentication daemon's memory usage, performs many web-auth logins, then re-checks memory and confirms it has not grown.

1331.2001.39474.description:
CR39474 - x600(Ver.5.4.1-2.12) duplicate master issue.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the fix for a duplicate-master issue by confirming high-priority control traffic reaches the CPU correctly. Crafts packets with the highest CoS destined for the switch CPU, clears the SDMA counters, transmits the packets to a port, and confirms they are all received on the expected CPU queue.

1331.2001.39564.description:
CR39564 - SNMP GET/Walk of VLAN4094 crashes

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that an SNMP GET/walk of VLAN 4094 no longer crashes the switch. Performs an SNMP walk and confirms it completes without timeout, then changes the boot configuration and power-cycles, proving the device stays up rather than crashing.

1331.2001.40312.description:
CR40312 - The forwarded packet by UDP broadcast helper could be wrong

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that packets forwarded by the UDP broadcast helper have the correct checksum. Crafts a UDP packet, sends it to be relayed by the switch, captures the forwarded packets on the connected test box, and confirms each received packet's UDP checksum matches its recalculated value.

1331.2001.40512.description:
CR40512 - Web authentication page does not open after failing to Web authenticate once.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the web authentication page opens again after a failed authentication attempt. Attempts to authenticate with an incorrect password on a port from the test box and confirms the web authentication gateway page is still served afterwards rather than being blocked.

1331.2001.41149.description:
CR41149 - Part of the ClientID in "show ip dhcp binding" is incorrect value.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the ClientID shown in the DHCP binding output is correct. Has clients with a range of MAC addresses request leases from the switch DHCP server and confirms each binding's ClientId is displayed as the client's correct MAC address.

1331.2001.41668.description:
CR41668 - Significant reduction in SNMP MIBS returned by SNMP WALK.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that an SNMP walk returns the full set of MIB objects rather than a reduced number. Waits for the stack to be in a good state and SNMP to be configured, then performs simultaneous SNMPv2c and SNMPv3 walks of the full tree and confirms a large, consistent object count is returned with the stack still healthy.

1331.2001.42428.description:
CR42428 - Boot fail with imi core due to ntp access-group peer OR serve-only

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that the device boots cleanly (no IMI core) when NTP access-group peer or serve-only ACLs are configured. It would configure NTP ACLs, reboot, and confirm no core dump occurs. Reported UNSUPPORTED on the current setup because the required NTP ACLs could not be established.

1331.2001.42429.description:
CR42429 - Authorised supplicant does not success re-authenticate after VCS failover.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that an authorised 802.1X supplicant re-authenticates successfully after a VCS failover. It would authenticate a supplicant, force a master failover, and confirm re-authentication succeeds on the new master. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it is not applicable on standalone (non-stacked) devices.

1331.2001.50090.description:
CR50090 - VCS : Unable to execute stack management subnet command on x900/x908

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that the "stack management subnet" command can be executed on x900/x908 platforms. It would configure a stack management subnet and confirm the setting is accepted and shown in the running config. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires the relevant stacked platform (ran on a single unit).

1331.2001.52114.description:
CR52114 - IPv6 address configured on VLAN interface with VRRP after IPv4 address is removed causes crash

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that configuring an IPv6 address on a VRRP-enabled VLAN interface after the IPv4 address is removed does not crash the switch. Confirms VRRP is configured, removes the IPv4 address from the VLAN interface, adds an IPv6 address, and reconfigures the IPv4 address, confirming the operations succeed without a crash.

1331.2001.52275.description:
CR52275 - Following logs are displayed every vlan interface become "Up" when any VLAN was shutdown and destination network address is configured as /32.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that spurious logs are no longer emitted each time a VLAN interface comes up when a VLAN is shut down and a host-route destination network is configured. Captures the logs before the action, exercises the VLAN up transitions with the relevant configuration, and confirms the erroneous log messages do not appear.

1331.2001.52388.description:
CR52388 - X510 switch - not processing arp replies

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the switch correctly processes ARP replies. Confirms the switch can ping hosts on each VLAN, then removes ports from their VLANs and shuts them down, confirming the VLAN interfaces go down as expected and that ARP-driven reachability behaves correctly.

1331.2001.52447.description:
CR52447 - Value of the start time of the ARP registration is not cleared after 150 seconds.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the ARP registration start-time (begin) counter is cleared after the expiry interval. Clears the ARP cache and pings hosts to set the begin counters on each VLAN, confirms the counters are set, then waits past the expiry interval and confirms each VLAN's begin counter has been reset to zero.

1331.2001.52560.description:
CR52560 - If NTP Source is configured before a NTP Server, that server does not work

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that an NTP server still works when an NTP source is configured before the server. Confirms NTP associations are healthy, deconfigures the servers, configures the NTP source, then reconfigures the servers and confirms the associations are established correctly.

1331.2001.52835.description:
CR52835 - PQR-N0088:The communication of the supplicant on auth port is Software Routing after authentication is successful.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that an authenticated supplicant's traffic on an auth port is hardware-switched, not software-routed via the CPU. It would authorise the supplicant, send traffic, and confirm SDMA/CPU counters stay at zero. Reported UNSUPPORTED on the current setup because the supplicant could not be authorised as required.

1331.2001.52960.description:
authd crash with repeated invalid login/logout

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that authd does not crash under repeated invalid web-authentication attempts. Starts a RADIUS server and performs many web-auth logins with invalid credentials, confirming the authentication daemon survives without crashing.

1331.2001.54553.description:
RIP metric is not updated properly when receiving the update packets

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a RIP route metric is updated correctly when update packets are received. Learns a route via RIP, then sends an update with an unreachable metric immediately followed by an update with a reachable metric, and confirms the route is retained with the correct metric rather than being removed.

1331.2001.54594.description:
Traffic rate will be low after the route change

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that traffic throughput is not reduced after a route change. Measures UDP packet throughput between test-box interfaces through the switch, adds and removes a static route, and re-measures, confirming all packets are still forwarded at full rate after the route change.

1331.2001.80760.description:
VCS+ duplicate master after rebooting line cards

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that rebooting line cards does not produce a duplicate VCS master. It would reboot line cards and confirm a single Active Master is maintained. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member VCS stack (skipped on this single unit).

1331.3001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1331.3001.32711.description:
CR32711 - A DUT can not control IPv6 Packets using Hardware MAC ACL.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that the DUT can control IPv6 packets using a hardware MAC ACL. It would apply a MAC ACL, send IPv6 traffic, and confirm matching packets are permitted/denied per the ACL. Reported UNSUPPORTED because the required hardware ACL handling is not available on this device.

1331.3001.38348.description:
CR38348 - When x610 VCS started in 5.4.2-3.10 at Kochi University of Technology, nsm process of all stacks raised to more 80%.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that crafted and malformed IPv6/ICMPv6 packets do not drive the NSM process CPU usage high. Transmits a series of corrupt packets and the full range of ICMPv6 types to the VLAN interface, then confirms the NSM process CPU usage stays low.

1331.3001.42576.description:
CR42576 - When one of configured ipv6 address is removed dynamically, communication to other configured ipv6 address fail.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that dynamically removing one configured IPv6 address does not break communication to the other configured IPv6 addresses. It would configure multiple IPv6 subnets, remove one, and confirm connectivity to the remaining addresses is unaffected. Reported UNSUPPORTED because the required IPv6 hardware forwarding entries are not available on this device.

1331.3001.51954.description:
CR51954 - index.cgi core dump will be created by HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1 request

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that an HTTP request without a Host header no longer causes the index.cgi process to core dump. Sends an HTTP GET request for a GUI session omitting the Host parameter and confirms the HTTP server returns a 400 Bad Request rather than crashing.

1331.3001.54355.description:
CR54355 - NSM process crash occurs in "set ip next-hop" command

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the NSM process does not crash on the 'set ip next-hop' command sequence. Configures a basic class map and runs the command sequence that previously caused an NSM crash, confirming the 'no set ip next-hop' command is handled without a crash.

1331.3001.57026.description:
CR57026 - A dynamic vlan assignment does not work by vlan name (same as CR00024669)

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that dynamic VLAN assignment by VLAN name works. Crafts an authentication packet from the connected test box and confirms the supplicant is authorized and assigned the correct dynamic VLAN ID via the named VLAN.

1331.3001.71439.description:
VLAN cannot isolate IPv6 traffic

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a VLAN can isolate IPv6 traffic. Confirms IPv6 traffic is forwarded between ports while the VLAN interface has an IPv6 address, then removes the IPv6 address and confirms traffic is no longer forwarded in either direction.
